page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Main text in one column of full width, with an engraving (woodcut of the crucifixion) in the left lower part and a narrow text column to its right, which continues the paragraph. Marginal notes on the left (three) and right (two) of the upper text. Catchword "quasi" at the foot right, signature "G 2" at the foot.

main_text.l: En, inquiunt, mediusille finis tabella est in quâ corpus
requiescit. Fateor verba huc ire, nec teme-
re contenderim de alienâ mente. Tamen Iustinus
martyr, è quo sumpta haec videntur, sic de isto fine: Καὶ τὸ ἐν τῷ μέσῳ πεπηγνύμενον ξύλον ὡς
κέρας ἔχον ἐστὶν, ἐφ' ᾧ ἐπονχοιῶνται ⓐ σαυρούμενοι: Et illud in medio desixum lignum, ut cornu

l.i: ipsum etiam eminet, in quo feruntur & quasi inuebuntur,

main_text.l: qui crucifiguntur. Cornu id appellat, & notare
vult: quomodo aptè in planâ hac tabellâ? Videndum ne
vterque ille scriptor aliud intellegat à iam
dicto sensu. Diuidunt crucem in quinque
Engraving: crucifixion scene, a figure on a cross with a stake; towns in the background.

page.notes: Engraving in the left lower part of the page; description only. Marginal note texts on the left and right are partly faint; "Vide sup." and "cap. VIII." read as printed. The Greek passage is copied as best read. The line "quasi" at the foot is a catchword and also the first word of the next page.
